senses.definition: carcass, of lion, מ׳ cstr. Ju 14:8.
a ruin, מַפַּלְתּוֹ Ez 31:13 (kg. under fig. of tree).
overthrow, id. v 16 (same fig.); מַפַּלְתֶּ֑ךָ (kg.) 32:10; מַפַּלְתֵּךְ (of Tyre) 26:15, 18; 27:27; מַפַּלְתָּם (of wicked) Pr 29:16.
